items.title: Request preparation and plugin transforms

details.condition: LLMRequestPrep.prepare runs before the selected runtime executes.
details.summary: agent.prompt replaces provider prompt; then input.system and user.system append. Plugins may transform system, params and headers. Options merge base, model, agent and selected user variant in that order. OpenAI OAuth puts system text into instructions instead of system messages; GitLab workflows have a separate systemPrompt path.

items.title: Session identity headers and overrides

details.condition: Prepared request headers go to the selected runtime; model headers then plugin headers can override earlier fields.
details.summary: x-opencode-session-id and optional x-opencode-parent-session-id provide explicit identity. Non-opencode providers also get x-session-affinity and X-Session-Id. Header presence in source does not prove the final captured request includes them.

items.title: Final request tool filtering

details.condition: After params/headers hooks, resolveTools applies agent/session permissions and per-user tools disablement; selected Responses-family tools have strict false.
details.summary: GitHub Copilot may gain a compatibility _noop tool only when no tools remain and replayed history contains tool calls.

items.title: Final permission and user-tools gate

details.condition: resolveTools is called during request preparation.
details.summary: Tool presence in the registry differs from final request inclusion.

items.title: Core runner request identity and context

details.condition: Separate core SessionRunner source path constructs a request.
details.summary: Adds exact session/parent headers, model request, agent system and context baseline. Live runtime evidence is needed to identify which path produced a capture.

items.title: Default AI SDK and opt-in native runtime

details.condition: experimentalNativeLlm attempts native runtime; unsupported status falls back to AI SDK. Otherwise streamText is the default path.
details.summary: Default path passes prepared headers/messages/tools/options and applies ProviderTransform.message through middleware before SDK serialization.

items.title: Native runtime support gate

details.condition: Only when experimentalNativeLlm is enabled and this status gate succeeds.
details.summary: Accepts provider IDs openai, anthropic or starting opencode, with supported SDK packages and configured API key; OAuth additionally needs the OpenAI fetch override. OpenRouter/Alibaba/DeepSeek/Moonshot do not pass this provider-ID gate.

items.title: Native request conversion and adapter selection

details.condition: Native request adapter invoked only by a caller whose runtime support gate admits it; standalone package adapters are not proof of main CLI use.
details.summary: Converts system messages, text, media, reasoning, tools and provider metadata into canonical LLM requests; selects adapters by model.api.npm.

items.title: Native reasoning summary deltas and opaque metadata

details.condition: Native OpenAI Responses stream receives reasoning summary and output-item events.
details.summary: Summary deltas become visible reasoning events, while encrypted_content stays in provider metadata. Ordering is handled on a best-effort basis when events are unexpected.

items.title: Native JSON export boundary

details.condition: User explicitly runs export for a real session; optional sanitize mode redacts transcript/file data.
details.summary: Writes {info,messages}, where each message carries info and parts from session storage. This is stored session evidence, not the fully assembled request or exact system prompt.

items.title: Native package OpenRouter protocol

details.condition: Standalone native package OpenRouter route is selected; main CLI native runtime gate restricts provider IDs separately.
details.summary: Uses OpenAI Chat stream protocol at /chat/completions, adding usage/reasoning/prompt-cache body options. Default host comes from the native profile. It does not establish an observed serving provider or downstream hop.

items.title: Native OpenAI-compatible endpoint profiles

details.condition: Native package provider helpers use their default profile unless baseURL is overridden.
details.summary: Includes openrouter.ai/api/v1 and api.deepseek.com/v1. Main CLI endpoint defaults may instead come from the dynamic catalog or config.

items.title: Native Chat request and response fields

details.condition: Native OpenAI Chat-compatible protocol serializes a canonical request and decodes SSE events.
details.summary: Source schema separates system/user/assistant/tool content, tool function schemas, reasoning_content, usage.reasoning_tokens and finish_reason. This native schema is not proof of the default external SDK wire format.

details.condition: Provider.resolveSDK selects factory using the configured or catalog-derived model.api.npm.
details.summary: Includes OpenRouter, Alibaba and OpenAI-compatible SDK factories. SDK dependency versions are pinned in packages/opencode/package.json, separately from installed CLI identity.

items.title: OpenRouter attribution headers

details.condition: OpenRouter custom provider loader is used and headers are not overridden downstream.
details.summary: Sets HTTP-Referer and X-Title for the client. These headers do not identify an upstream serving provider.

items.title: Model endpoint, capabilities and options

details.condition: Config-defined model is merged with existing/catalog defaults.
details.summary: api.id, npm package and URL have separate precedence. Interleaved reasoning can be configured; a new OpenAI-compatible DeepSeek model defaults to reasoning_content. Model options and headers are merged, and configured variants can disable defaults.

items.title: Resolved SDK endpoint and fetch layer

details.condition: resolveSDK loads the selected provider package.
details.summary: Nonempty provider.options.baseURL takes precedence over model.api.url, then configured/environment substitutions apply. Provider credentials and model headers are merged before the timeout-aware fetch wrapper. Actual captured host remains the evidence of client destination.

items.title: Runtime model catalog source

details.condition: ModelsDev loads cache/OPENCODE_MODELS_PATH, build-injected snapshot, or network fetch when enabled; periodic refresh is conditional.
details.summary: Catalog URL defaults to models.opencode.ai and can be overridden. Provider endpoints/capabilities from a live catalog are not frozen by this source pin and are not copied into this inventory.

items.title: Provider option namespaces

details.condition: ProviderTransform.providerOptions is called before SDK execution.
details.summary: Maps package to expected namespace; Azure receives openai and azure; gateway options split routing controls from model publisher options. Provider IDs and model publishers are distinct.

items.title: DeepSeek and interleaved reasoning replay

details.condition: ProviderTransform normalization applies after preceding provider-specific branches; DeepSeek names receive empty reasoning placeholders when missing.
details.summary: Configured interleaved reasoning fields move assistant reasoning into OpenAI-compatible message options, excluding the OpenRouter SDK path. Empty placeholders are harness compatibility data, not evidence of model reasoning.

items.title: Provider reasoning and usage defaults

details.condition: ProviderTransform.options or smallOptions creates defaults before model/agent/user variant merges.
details.summary: OpenRouter requests usage inclusion. Kimi Anthropic-compatible reasoning uses adaptive summarized thinking/high effort. Alibaba-cn OpenAI-compatible reasoning enables thinking except kimi-k2-thinking. Small-model options may disable reasoning. Source settings do not establish visible returned reasoning.

items.title: Reasoning variant fallback branches

details.condition: Reasoning capability enabled and no authoritative reasoning_options variants supersede these fallback branches.
details.summary: Kimi on Anthropic-compatible transports has adaptive thinking efforts. Earlier DeepSeek/Kimi/Qwen name branches return no generic variants. OpenRouter effort variants only apply if earlier branches did not return.

items.title: Catalog-defined reasoning controls

details.condition: Model catalog provides reasoning_options; effort, toggle or token-budget variants are mapped to selected SDK settings.
details.summary: OpenRouter maps effort/budget to reasoning; Alibaba maps toggle/budget to enableThinking/thinkingBudget. This is configuration mapping, not provider response evidence.

items.title: AI SDK stream normalization

details.condition: Default AI SDK runtime fullStream is converted into canonical LLMEvents.
details.summary: Reasoning start/delta/end remain separate from text; usage and finish metadata are normalized; errors fail the stream. This code does not reconstruct hidden/encrypted reasoning.

items.title: Visible reasoning persistence
items.text:
const handleEvent = Effect.fnUntraced(function* (value: StreamEvent) {
        switch (value.type) {
          case "reasoning-start":
            if (value.id in ctx.reasoningMap) return
            ctx.reasoningMap[value.id] = {
              id: PartID.ascending(),
              messageID: ctx.assistantMessage.id,
              sessionID: ctx.assistantMessage.sessionID,
              type: "reasoning",
              text: "",
              time: { start: Date.now() },
              metadata: value.providerMetadata,
            }
            yield* session.updatePart(ctx.reasoningMap[value.id])
            return

          case "reasoning-delta":
            // Match dev: silently drop orphan deltas (no preceding reasoning-start).
            if (!(value.id in ctx.reasoningMap)) return
            ctx.reasoningMap[value.id].text += value.text
            if (value.providerMetadata) ctx.reasoningMap[value.id].metadata = value.providerMetadata
            yield* session.updatePartDelta({
              sessionID: ctx.reasoningMap[value.id].sessionID,
              messageID: ctx.reasoningMap[value.id].messageID,
              partID: ctx.reasoningMap[value.id].id,
              field: "text",
              delta: value.text,
            })
            return

          case "reasoning-end":
            if (value.providerMetadata && value.id in ctx.reasoningMap) {
              ctx.reasoningMap[value.id].metadata = value.providerMetadata
            }
            yield* finishReasoning(value.id)
            return

details.condition: Reasoning events arrive from the selected runtime with a preceding reasoning-start.
details.summary: Persists distinct reasoning parts and provider metadata. Orphan reasoning deltas are dropped, so stored exports can differ from raw wire streams.

items.title: Step finish, usage and provider transformations

details.condition: Session processor receives step-finish from the selected runtime.
details.summary: Stores finish reason and normalized tokens/cost; logs provider-reported dropped thinking blocks and closes remaining reasoning parts. Raw capture is needed to inspect metadata that does not survive export.

items.title: Opaque reasoning replay metadata

details.condition: Native OpenAI Responses lowering sees a reasoning part with valid provider item ID metadata.
details.summary: Visible part text becomes summary_text; reasoningEncryptedContent is passed separately as opaque encrypted_content or null. Encrypted bytes are not readable reasoning text.

items.title: Stored assistant history replay and model changes

details.condition: MessageV2 converts stored session parts for a new selected provider/model.
details.summary: For the same model, reasoning parts preserve provider metadata. When model changes, nonempty reasoning becomes text and metadata is omitted. Completed, failed and interrupted tools have separate replay paths.
